displayIdentity.body: Paul speaks of jealousy, another Jesus, a different spirit, and a different message of good news. He names deceitful workers who disguise themselves. Satan also disguises himself as an angel of light, and his servants pose as servants of righteousness. Their end will match their works.
displayIdentity.title: Paul says Satan masquerades as an angel of light
